root_cause: The v1 independent verifier computed builder_base_passes from list(result.pass_map)[:-2]. The builder writes JSON with sort_keys=true, so deserialization alphabetically orders pass_map keys and the last two keys are not guaranteed to be INDEPENDENT_REPLAY_PASS and PRESEAL_COMPLETENESS_PASS. All substantive independent checks printed in the assertion payload were true; only builder_base_passes was false.
repair_policy: Append-only successor verifier/preseal must derive the exact 38-name authority from the frozen preregistration and compare key sets explicitly; v1 files and run1 remain immutable historical evidence.
